category_seo.title: Web3 Identity - ENS, Lens & Decentralized Identity | BiuBiu Tools
category_seo.description: Decentralized identity solutions for Web3. Domain names (ENS), social profiles (Lens), credentials, and reputation systems.

faqs.question: What is Web3 identity?
faqs.answer: Web3 identity lets you own your digital identity on-chain. This includes domain names (ENS), social profiles (Lens), verifiable credentials, and reputation scores across dApps.

faqs.question: Should I get an ENS domain?
faqs.answer: Yes, ENS domains replace complex wallet addresses with readable names (yourname.eth). They work across wallets and dApps. You can also use them as decentralized websites.

faqs.question: What is Lens Protocol?
faqs.answer: Lens Protocol is a decentralized social graph where you own your profile, content, and followers as NFTs. Apps built on Lens include Lenster, Hey, and Orb.
